country.name: Belgium (BELX reference)
country.notes: Belgian reference case of the McMarcel framework, built from the public-release inputs of the repository. The country-specific input files (BELX, ESPX, RESCEUX) carry stochastic perturbation, so the values are not the observed Belgian values: every perturbed parameter is marked SYNTHETIC, production mode is blocked and every run is stamped. Use this pack to reproduce and validate the reference model, not to describe Belgium.

cost_outpatient_under1y.label: Outpatient cost, under 1 year
cost_outpatient_under1y.notes: Public-release perturbed Belgian outpatient unit cost for this age band.

cost_outpatient_under1y_sd.label: Outpatient cost, under 1 year, SD
cost_outpatient_under1y_sd.notes: Standard error derived from the published confidence interval as (uci - lci) / (2 x 1.96). The public-release perturbation can invert the bounds, so the absolute value is used.

qol_mean.label: Mean population utility
qol_mean.source: input/eq5d/popnormINDEX.rds (EQ-5D Belgian general population norms, BE 2018)
qol_mean.notes: Mean of the age-specific population means over the first 60 months; only used when a life table has to be generated.

analysis_perspective.label: Analysis perspective

gdp_fx_usd.label: Exchange rate, local currency per USD
gdp_fx_usd.notes: Not used by the engine; the Belgian analysis is entirely in euro.

wtp_multiplier_0_5.label: WTP threshold, 0.5x GDP
